reviews.title: I’m loving my new Bella Coffee Machine
reviews.body: I love Bella products! I ordered the Milk Oat Coffee pot for my husband and he loves it!!Very stylish and you can even buy Bella matching toaster!!! I just put 1 on my Mother’s Day list for my children.I also love that it takes hardly any counter space.My husband also has commented how hot the first cup of coffee was and continued to stay that temperature. The Automatic Turn Off is Automatic. I love that for the simple reason that I don’t like any electronics on, when I am not here. I will not wash or dry clothes without me being home.This is a great product at a Fantastic Price!!!I do not even hear it brewing when my husband has set the alarm, to go off 15 minutes before he wakes up. He also started that the Brew Strength and Speed were Excellent!!!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 6, 2026
reviews.author: Teresa Wade

reviews.title: Beautiful sleak design, but the thing stopped working after only a few weeks.
reviews.body: Loved the way it looks; very sleek and perfect for small counter space. Loved EVERYTHING bout the look and design of this product, now if only it would work more than the few weeks I had it.  Yes, sorry to say, it simply stopped working only a few weeks into its stay here in our kitchen.  The control interface was a bit user-unfriendly at first, but once I got use to it, I was able to make it work for us, until one day only a few weeks into using it , it just stopped working completely. Everything lit up but no water boiled into the carafe.  Tried everything I could think of to no avail.  We now have a very sleek, beautiful looking flower pot.  You can also use it as a doorstop.----------PS -- this is what  you get for not reading all the one and two star reviews!  So many all say they had my problem -- stops heating and sending out boiling water over the coffee grinds.  Dead after a couple of months -- exactly the same as mine.  This can't be a coincidense or a one-off bad unit.  This is a problem big enough that I strongly suggest you don't take a chance with this product.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 20, 2026

reviews.title: Only last 2 months
reviews.body: ⭐⭐⭐☆☆I absolutely loved this coffee pot at first! It was easy to use, brewed great coffee, and worked exactly as expected. Unfortunately, I purchased it on May 20, 2026, and after only about 2 months, it completely stopped working. I’m really disappointed because it was a fantastic coffee maker while it lasted. I expected it to last much longer than that. Great product when it works, but the short lifespan was very frustrating.

features: Wake up to fresh coffee: Program your brew up to 24 hours ahead so it's ready when you are. Designed for busy mornings and effortless routines, this coffee maker puts convenience on your countertop.
Clear, simple display: The easy-to-read digital screen makes it effortless to program your brew, check the time, or make adjustments—even on your sleepiest mornings.
Pour mid-brew with ease: The pause and serve feature lets you grab a cup while coffee's still brewing—no mess, no wait. Perfect for busy mornings when every second counts.
Sustainable and simple: Comes with a reusable filter basket and measuring scoop, so you can skip the paper waste and enjoy a hassle-free brew every time.
